jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Java)
jobs_results.description:
About Caravelo

Caravelo partners with airlines globally to increase productivity, revenue, and customer experience.

Founded in 2010, our mission is to modernize the industry's complex legacy systems. Through our SaaS platform, airlines can boost customer loyalty and unlock hidden revenue. Highly tailored to the market, region and customer-base, our key products include chatbots, subscriptions and upgrades.

With 49 team members and over $3M in funding so far, we are growing at a fast rate. In the past decade of uniting passengers and airlines, we are recognised as the go-to provider for true innovation.

Are you looking for your next job at a successful enterprise SaaS scaleup, being part of an international and bright team? We are looking for our next Backend Developer to join our DEV team!

The mission

You will build great quality software that contributes to the continuous improvement and evolution of Caravelo SaaS products, by analyzing business requirements, designing... technical implementations, coding elegant, solid and extendable solutions, improving software performance and error handling, cooperating with other developers and product specialists, and delivering on time by coordinating with tech leads.

Duties and responsibilities

Reporting To The CTO, You Will
• Implement existing product lines and help us develop new ones!
• Integrate our product lines with Airlines' reservation and payment systems (Sabre, Amadeus, Navitaire)
• Develop REST APIs
• Support new business domains and use cases
• Personalize our existing product lines to adapt to our partners' needs

Required Skills And Experience
• You are proficient in object-oriented analysis and design.
• You have solid Java/JVM or equivalent programming skills.
• You have at least 2+ years of experience as a backend developer.
• If you have any knowledge of Airline IT (i.e. Amadeus, Navitaire, Sabre, SITA) will be highly valued.
• It'd be great (but not mandatory) if you have any front-end knowledge or experience.
• You can communicate fluently in English (it's our company language!). Any Spanish knowledge is more than welcome!

Besides tech skills, we really value in a candidate:
• Passion: you are happy to work independently in a group and you enjoy sharing your expertise with junior team members and have a good sense of humour.
• Curiosity: develop new product lines is intriguing to you because you are full of ideas.
• You are autonomous and proactive.
• You’re versatile and enjoy learning new technologies and languages
• You are action-orientated and with enthusiasm

What we offer
• Possibility to work Full-Remote and with flexible working hours
• We offer you a competitive salary according to your experience.
• If you live in Spain, you will access to benefits paid from your gross salary (Health insurance, Transport/Restaurant/Kindergarten check) and discounted gym membership.
• You will be joining a fast-moving and progressive company that prides itself on being at the forefront of software development within the airline industry.
• A real chance to grow: there's plenty of room for personal development.
• The possibility to really see an impact and to see how your work affects the end result.

At Caravelo we are always looking for people with the right mix of passion, authenticity, and attitude to join our team. We are also proud to be an inclusive, equal opportunity employer

jobs_results.title: FULLSTACK DEVELOPER BACK-END FIRST
jobs_results.description:
Buscamos a un profesional con pasión por la tecnología y un enfoque práctico en el desarrollo de backend.

Deberás tener:
• Experiencia avanzada en desarrollo backend: Profundo conocimiento en Python, FastAPI, y Express, con al menos 2-3 años de experiencia en desarrollo backend, incluyendo la implementación de aplicaciones en entornos de producción.
• Creación y consumo de API Rest: Experiencia en el desarrollo y uso de API REST y adopción del enfoque “API First”.
• Arquitectura y diseño de software: Conocimientos en arquitectura hexagonal/limpia y Diseño Dirigido por el Dominio (DDD).
• Gestión de bases de datos complejas: Experiencia en la gestión y optimización de bases de datos relacionales (MySQL, PostgreSQL) y NoSQL (MongoDB), incluyendo bases de datos geolocalizadas y de series temporales.
• Prácticas avanzadas de desarrollo y testing: Experiencia en implementar prácticas de desarrollo de código limpio, SOLID, TDD, y CI/CD utilizando herramientas como Docker y Kubernetes.
•... Integración de tecnologías emergentes: Experiencia en la integración de tecnologías emergentes como GIS, IIoT, IoT, y ML/DL para fortalecer el producto…

Formación académica:

Grado superior en Ingeniería Informática o titulación similar.

Idiomas:

Nivel alto de inglés.

Experiencia:

M  nimo 2-3 años de experiencia como desarrollador back-end.

¡Si buscas un desafío apasionante en el mundo IT, envíanos tu currículum ahora y únete a nuestro equipo de profesionales líderes en el sector

jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Java) - 23421
jobs_results.description:
Description

Why YOU want this position

Enverus has expanded its solutions in Power & Renewables with the addition of RatedPower. A high growth start-up, RatedPower’s technology expands our portfolio of solutions in solar with its cloud-based software that automates and optimizes the feasibility study, analysis, design and engineering of solar power plants, and our geographical coverage internationally.

Enverus is the leading energy SaaS company delivering highly technical insights and predictive/prescriptive analytics that empower customers to make decisions that increase profit. Enverus’ innovative technologies drive production and investment strategies, enable best practices for energy and commodity trading and risk management, and reduce costs through automated processes across critical business functions. Enverus is a strategic partner to more than 6,000 customers in 50 countries.

We are currently seeking a Backend Developer to join our RatedPower team working in Madrid or... remote. This role offers the opportunity to join a rapidly growing company delivering industry-leading solutions. Be a part of the energy transition and join our growing team, creating intelligent connections across the energy value chain with a strategic focus on growing our offerings in Power & Renewables.

What You’ll Do
• Improve pvDesign by developing new or improving functionalities, with efficient, reusable, and easy to maintain code.
• Collaborate with Product, Design, QA, Frontend teams, to frame and tackle the challenges, both from a technical and business context.
• Manage and improve CI procedures.
• Administrate and maintain cloud infrastructure with guidance from our devSecOps engineers.
• Identify and implement improvements that reduce technical debt and enable the team to iterate faster.

What You Should Have
• Experience working with Java, SpringBoot, and object-oriented programming
• Experience working with relational databases like MySQL and non-relational like mongoDB
• Strong motivation to drive impact by making product or infrastructure improvements
• Previous experience writing unitary tests
• Deep understanding of architectural principles and design patterns
• Proactiveness, team player and willingness to teach & learn from peer
• Continuous integration and issue tracking tools such JIRA

What We Offer
• Face new and amazing challenges leveraging the newest technologies: we work with SpringBoot, GraphQL, Java 17, MySQL 8.0, AWS, automated testing, etc.
• You choose: position fully remote (based in Spain) or hybrid working model (able to combine working from home and from our office in Madrid city center).
• Career development according to your aspirations and interests.
• Opportunity to develop yourself and to be part of a fast-growing startup. You'll have a direct impact on our way of working and decisions made in the business

jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Workfully is the decentralized hiring & upskilling marketplace. The world's fastest growing and most innovative companies use Workfully to hire & develop talent globally.

Our platform empowers independent recruiters to expand, engage, and monetize their talent networks by connecting them with meaningful opportunities at leading companies worldwide. As an early-stage startup, we achieved profitability within our first year of operation, serving global clients such as TravelPerk, OLX, BlackBerry, Accenture, Inditex, FreeNow, and more.

About the Role:

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who is passionate about technology and product development to help us lay the foundations for the premier recruitment platform on the market.

Requirements:
• Knowledge of the Node.js ecosystem, including TypeScript, common libraries, and frameworks
• Self-motivated and high-performing, with a passion for both business and technology
• Deep understanding of software design, object orientation... architectural principles, and API design
• Analytical thinking and experience making product decisions based on data
• Nice-to-have skills include knowledge in TDD, DDD, Pair programming techniques, and experience with Continuous Integration pipelines and tools, familiarity with Front End technologies, and knowledge of refactoring techniques

Why Join Workfully:
• Opportunity to build and lead something from scratch
• Thrive in a fast-paced environment and work on meaningful challenges
• Value equity ownership
• Hybrid setup: 3 days remote work, 2 days office
• Office at Norrsken House Barcelona

jobs_results.title: Backend Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for a Backend Engineer for our functional squads who loves learning new things and facing new challenges but we also value it if you have some deep experience in specific topics such as design systems, scalability, XP practices, web development, etc.

At Nextail, you will be part of a cross-functional and autonomous team where you will lead the frontend development of the new modules of our Product. You will collaborate with Product and Design people to build the best user experience for our customers. We love developers with a strong Product and Agile mindset who values good technical practices. Developers who are eager to learn new things and face new challenges of usability and scalability. Developers who enjoy staying close to Production, doing continuous deployment with special care on quality.

We are a remote company, but you can also work in Madrid offices. At the moment, we are only seeking candidates in Europe (UTC+02:00 or similar).

Responsibilities:

You... will be part of one of our functional teams and your goals will be focused on:
• Building market-first solutions for retailers. Our teams work to solve the problems faced by retailers by helping them make decisions. Whether by better data analytics or by automating decision processes.
• Reach better solutions through multidisciplinary teams. Product Managers, Developers, Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Data Engineers, and Business Experts work together to solve end-to-end problems.
• Your job will not be finished when the end-to-end solution is in production, or after the change management and operational details are closed, not even when we have strong evidence that the solution is solving the user problem and she is satisfied because after that we continue monitoring and working in improving our solutions.
• Discussion between pairs, working together, and challenging each other, is the fastest way to solve a problem. We have a culture of sharing, transparency, meritocracy, caring, and trusting each other. When developing, we always consider providing maximum value to our users.

Job Requirements:

First, we are looking for a good workmate to join the team. We value working in a safe and constructive environment where everybody can thrive over any specific technical skill.

In our team, you will also find people focused on generating an impact in the company, rather than just taking on new tasks to develop. We expect that the person who joins us is as excited about this bias towards impact and action as we are. The requirements and valued skills for this job are:
• Large background as a Backend Developer building complex products and working as a part of a cross-functional team
• Solid experience with Python or Java. We don't discriminate by frameworks, we are looking for the right kind of person, even if you have to transition to other technologies.
• Knowledge and interest in design patterns, SOLID, Hexagonal Architecture; everything related to software architecture and design.
• Knowledge and experience applying good development practices like TDD, CI/CD, etc.
• Experience working in fast-paced product-oriented startups.
• Being a team player with solid skills of collaboration and initiative
• Proficiency in English

We offer:
• High flexibility: We’re strong believers that what matters most are results. Each Nextailer is empowered, through trust and ownership, to organize their time as they see fit without jeopardizing the time or work of their colleagues.
• Remote-first philosophy: Nextail started as a remote company and continues to offer a nice mix of remote and/or office-based environments around the world.
• International environment: We operate across the globe, with recent operations reaching from Europe to Australia, and our team alone consists of professionals of more than 15 different nationalities. While many of us are multilingual, our working language is English.
• Diversity on all levels: United as a single team, we celebrate diversity at every dimension*. Professionally speaking, are you ready to work alongside tech geniuses, data science magicians, and fashionistas? You’ll have teammates with extensive experience in a wide variety of professional fields, including technology, retail, consulting, and entrepreneurship.
• The laptop of your choice: Please work with the tools that are most comfortable for you!
• Flexible compensation plan: We offer a fixed + variable salary.
• Nextail is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

To all recruitment agencies: Nextail does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Nextail employees or any other organization location. Nextail is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes

Movilizamos grandes organizaciones para mejorar la relación entre las marcas y personas mediante el Diseño, los Datos y la Tecnología. Entendemos lo que nuestros clientes necesitan y orquestamos capacidades para lograr esos objetivos a una velocidad de vértigo. Nuestra cultura se basa en la diversidad, creatividad y en la mezcla de especialistas (estrategia, diseño, tecnología, data, investigación…) Nuestras carreras se caracterizan por un crecimiento profesional exponencial, y por la participación en proyectos con impacto real en grandes clientes. Formar parte de The Cocktail implica rodearse de un equipo inspirador del que aprender y que te ayudará a crecer. Trabajamos bajo la máxima de que es mejor pedir perdón que permiso, por eso, esperamos de ti una visión disruptiva y challenger, inconformismo y pasión por la excelencia y los desafíos.

Si... quieres moverte en un entorno retador, crear proyectos innovadores y hacer que las cosas pasen, The Cocktail es para ti.

Este es el reto.

Seguimos creciendo en el ámbito de plataformas y buscamos gente sin miedo a la velocidad, apasionada por implementar proyectos con soluciones DXP, que quiera liderar y extender el conocimiento relativo a Liferay en la parte de Back dentro de nuestros equipos de Tecnología. Todo ello en un entorno multidisciplinar, liderando el proceso de transformación digital de nuestros clientes junto con el resto de áreas de The Cocktail.

En tu día a día:
• Desarrollar e implementar proyectos con Liferay Portal (versiones 7.2 y 7.4)
• Participar en toda la vida del proyecto, desde el prototipado y análisis funcional hasta el análisis y liderazgo técnico.
• Implementación de portlets y Service Builders, como la gestión de contenidos y Microservicios
• Conocimientos en la gestión y adaptación del código fuente del CORE de Liferay para la realización de migraciones de datos
• Programación en Java siguiendo el modelo MVC portlet.
• Otros lenguajes; jquery, Hibernate, freemarker, Azure Devops/AWS, Github/Bitbucket, PostgresSQL/MySQL/Oracle
• Definir la mejor solución técnica junto al resto de equipos de Tecnología.
• Trabajar de forma conjunta con los equipos de UX, Diseño Estratégico, Negocio y Estrategia.
• Defender las fortalezas y aplicabilidad de la plataforma frente al resto de áreas y al cliente, tanto en español como en inglés.

Además, cuando lleves un tiempo aquí, esperamos que seas capaz de:
• Asegurar los planes y los procesos de calidad de un proyecto, desarrollando tests y llevando a cabo proceso s de CI/CD.
• Aprender otras tecnologías y lenguajes como Groovy y Kotlin.
• Trabajar con una filosofía 100% DevOps con herramientas como Jenkins, Docker y Kubernetes.
• Construir un entorno de reconocimiento y celebración. Apropiarte de la visión de la compañía y que la hagas propia.

¿Cómo es la experiencia en The Cocktail?
• Modelo de trabajo basado en la autorresponsabilidad y la autogestión con horario flexible y teletrabajo (de verdad). Decides tu horario, desde dónde trabajas y cómo lo haces.
• Buscamos la excelencia/mejora en lo que hacemos, generando un ambiente colaborativo. Nuestra filosofía es 70-20-10 (70% se aprende de la experiencia, 20% de mentores/referentes y 10% de formación reglada).
• Podrás disfrutar de 25 días de vacaciones al año repartidos entre verano y Navidad, sobre todo. También te regalamos Nochebuena y Nochevieja.
• Paquete de ventajas sociales y posibilidad de retribución flexible.
• No tenemos dress code. Ven como quieras a trabajar.
• Ser parte de una compañía con alma: tenemos iniciativas de apoyo a la maternidad (una sala de lactancia en la oficina y programas para mamás y papás), la sostenibilidad (políticas zero waste), la igualdad de género y diversidad (iniciativas de visibilización e inclusión del colectivo LGTB+, colaboraciones para disminuir la desigualdad social...).
• Descuentos y múltiples ventajas para tu ocio y día a día.

En The Cocktail pretendemos ser un referente en talento y calidad humana, y sólo lo conseguiremos siendo una compañía abierta y diversa, por eso tenemos un Código de Conducta que refleja nuestras expectativas de las personas que participan en la empresa. Ofrecemos un entorno acogedor para todos, independientemente de su identidad o expresión de género, orientación sexual, capacidad, origen, religión, estatus socioeconómico…

Próximos pasos:

Si has llegado hasta aquí es porque hemos conseguido llamar tu atención ;)

Apúntate a la oferta y el equipo de People echará un vistazo a tu CV. Si coincide con lo que buscamos, recibirás una llamada para conocernos mejor, que podamos contarte más sobre The Cocktail y el sobre el rol

jobs_results.title: Senior Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
Hay dos palabras que nos definen: talento y tecnología, porque en Scalian no entendemos una sin la otra. Nosotros ofrecemos soluciones sencillas e innovadoras a problemas complejos, que tienen un impacto positivo y sostenible en las organizaciones y en la sociedad. Pero para conseguirlo, necesitamos del talento, por eso, buscamos un/a Senior Backend Developer con experiencia en Java y Microservicios.

¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos un/a Senior Backend Developer con experiencia en Java/microservicios (Spring boot) para integrarse en nuestro equipo de profesionales de banca.

Experiencia a partir de 4 años o conocimientos avanzados en las siguientes tecnologías/herramientas:
• Arquitectura de microservicios
• Composición de APIs
• RestFul
• OpenAPI, Swagger
• Java 8, 11
• Spring (Spring-Boot, Spring-Batch, MVC)
• Maven
• Junit, Mockito, Wiremock, MockMVC
• JPA, Oracle, JDBC
• Docker / Kubernetes / Openshift
• Ansible
• Stack ELK (Elastic, LogStash, Kibana)
• Prometheus, Grafana
• Pipelines... CI/CD (build, deploy)
• Unix

Requisitos valorables que también podrás aprender con nosotros:
• Herramientas de análisis estático de código (Sonar, PMD, Checkstyle, etc)
• Bases de datos relacionales y NoSQL: Cassandra, Sparks, HortonWorks
• Redes
• Reglas de firewall
• Azure devOps
• Scala

¿Qué tendrás con nosotros?

Formar parte de un equipo de alto nivel bajo tecnologías punteras en el mercado.

💻 100% Teletrabajo

⛱ 25 días laborables de vacaciones

📝 Contrato indefinido

📚 Formación continua, certificaciones, meetups y planes de desarrollo profesional personalizados para que podamos seguir creciendo juntos. Contamos con acceso a plataformas internas con contenido abierto para que lo disfrutes cuando tú quieras y a tu ritmo.

🕐 Jornada completa con horario flexible para facilitar la conciliación entre vida familiar y profesional.

🎉 After works en las oficinas

🎂 La tarde del cumpleaños libre

🏋️♀️ Descuentos en gimnasios

💲Programas de retribución flexible: seguro médico, tarjeta restaurante, abono de transporte, cheques para escuelas infantiles.

🌏 Como parte del grupo Scalian, abrimos nuestras fronteras y crecemos internacionalmente.

♻️ En el grupo apostamos por iniciativas sostenibles.

¡Despega en tu carrera con Scalian Spain!✈
